core_claim: A transparent Elo-Poisson-Monte-Carlo model makes Argentina the 26.3% favourite for the 2026 World Cup, but the reader can re-run it to watch that favourite change, see where it disagrees with the FIFA ranking, and learn to read a forecast as a contestable, fully-audited claim rather than a prophecy.

interactive_centerpiece.reader_produces: The headline champion odds: at rest the bars show the published 26.3%/22.2%/... ; the reader drags a team's Elo slider and re-runs the in-browser Monte-Carlo (client_model), and the champion bars recompute live (e.g. Argentina -100 Elo -> Spain becomes favourite).
interactive_centerpiece.placement: at the reveal in edt_02 (immediately after the hook, before any disagreement/analysis sections) — the reader's action IS the reveal
interactive_centerpiece.degradation: static published champion bar chart if JS is disabled
interactive_centerpiece.note: This is the ONE earned centerpiece. ana_02-ana_05 charts are supporting visuals, not competing interactives.

edt_01.label: Hook — 26.3% on top
edt_01.editorial_notes: Lead with 26.3% (Argentina) exactly; do not pre-spoil that it is fragile — that lands in edt_02 via the explorable.

edt_02.label: Run it yourself — the explorable centerpiece
edt_02.title: Run it yourself
edt_02.editorial_notes: LOAD-BEARING. The explorable centerpiece (explorable_recompute via client_model). At rest show published bars (Argentina 26.3% ...); on slider+re-run, recompute live and animate. The Argentina -100 -> Spain-favourite outcome must be produced by the model, never hardcoded. Lands at the reveal.

edt_03.label: Why believe it — the honest model-health beat
edt_03.title: Why believe it
edt_03.editorial_notes: Keep BOTH numbers visible: model beats naive on 8000 games (0.900 vs 1.062) AND ties on the 28 played (1.068 vs 1.077). The tie is the honesty beat — do not bury it in a caveat.

edt_04.label: Where the model fights the FIFA ranking
edt_04.title: Where the model fights the ranking
edt_04.editorial_notes: Colombia FIFA#13->model#5 and Norway FIFA#31->model#10 are the load-bearing disagreements; ranks exact. Ties at the top (Argentina #1/#1) shown too.

edt_05.label: Money versus merit
edt_05.title: Money versus merit
edt_05.editorial_notes: France EUR1.52bn / 44.4% SF vs Colombia EUR302m / 25.2% SF; keep the EUR-per-SF-point framing exact.

edt_06.label: The coin still in the air — close on tension
edt_06.title: The coin still in the air
edt_06.editorial_notes: End on tension: 9 knife-edge teams + the 495-permutation conditional bracket + the 94.2% UEFA/CONMEBOL concentration, closing on 'an argument you can run yourself'. No summary, no marketing language.

edt_method.label: How the forecast is built (method band)
edt_method.title: How the model works
edt_method.editorial_notes: Plain-language explainer of the Elo->Poisson->Monte-Carlo recipe behind the 30.8% headline; transparency beat, no new numbers.

edt_histbase.label: Is 30.8% a lot? — the historical-favourite anchor
edt_histbase.title: Is 30.8% a lot?
edt_histbase.editorial_notes: Frame the model's 30.8% against the ~23% long-run favourite hit-rate and the eight-nations / repeat-champions history. Keep +7.8pp exact.

edt_predictor.label: Single-match predictor band
edt_predictor.title: Predict any match
edt_predictor.editorial_notes: The pick-two-teams predictor riding on the published champion/strength numbers; reader-driven, derived from the same model.

edt_oddsmkt.label: Model versus the betting market
edt_oddsmkt.title: Model vs market
edt_oddsmkt.editorial_notes: Where the model's order disagrees with the implied market/FIFA order; the disagreement is the story.

edt_scorecard.label: Model-health scorecard band
edt_scorecard.title: How good is the model, really?
edt_scorecard.editorial_notes: The honest scorecard: beats naive on 8000 games (0.900 vs 1.062) but ties on the 28 played (1.068 vs 1.077). Keep both visible.

edt_goals.label: Goals so far — golden boot and late drama
edt_goals.title: The race for the Golden Boot
edt_goals.editorial_notes: Messi leads on 5; 25.9% of goals from the 76th minute on; open-play 89.2%. Highlight video is a click-through FIFA/YouTube facade (sct_goals_video), demo embed only.

ratings.label: Player ability cards (EA Sports FC ratings)
ratings.title: The players behind the odds
ratings.editorial_notes: EA Sports FC overall + six face stats are CITED third-party values (sct_04 credits), NOT our computation; only the deep-run/champion odds beside each card come from the model. Portraits are publish-gated (swap to Wikimedia before public release).

edt_shootouts.label: Penalty shootouts are a coin flip
edt_shootouts.title: When it goes to penalties
edt_shootouts.editorial_notes: Across 678 shootouts the favourite wins only 53.7%; justifies the model's Elo-term knockout shortcut. Keep p=0.06 and the 17/35 WC-finals first-shooter number exact.
